# Car Lift UAE

> Daily car lift and carpooling service in the UAE. Connecting Sharjah, Ajman, and Dubai with safe, reliable, GPS-tracked shared rides since 2019.

## Services

- [Daily Car Lift](/services/daily-car-lift): Pay-per-trip shared rides from AED 25. No monthly commitment, book via WhatsApp the night before.
- [Monthly Car Lift](/services/monthly-car-lift): Monthly packages from AED 300/month. Salik included, 6 days/week.
- [Ladies Car Lift](/services/ladies-car-lift): Female-only car lift with verified female drivers for privacy and safety.
- [Office Transport](/services/office-transport): Corporate shuttle service for offices and businesses.
- [Staff Transport](/services/staff-transport): Bulk staff transport packages for companies.
- [Airport Transfer](/services/airport-transfer): Door-to-door airport pickup and drop-off.
- [Corporate Transport](/services/corporate-transport): Enterprise-level transport solutions.
- [School Transport](/services/school-transport): Safe school runs with verified drivers.
- [Private Car Lift](/services/private-car-lift): Dedicated vehicle for one passenger group.
- [Family Car Lift](/services/family-car-lift): Family-friendly shared transport.

## Routes & Pricing

- Sharjah (Al Nahda) → Business Bay: AED 300/month
- Sharjah (Al Khan, Al Majaz) → Business Bay: AED 330/month
- Sharjah (Al Taawun, Rolla) → Business Bay: AED 350/month
- Sharjah → DIFC / Downtown Dubai: AED 350/month
- Sharjah → Dubai Marina / JLT: AED 380/month
- Sharjah → Media City / Tecom: AED 380/month
- Ajman → Dubai (Business Bay): AED 420/month

## Key Facts

- Salik (toll) included in all monthly packages
- GPS-tracked vehicles
- Verified, licensed drivers
- 4.9★ rated by 247+ riders
- 6 days/week service (Monday–Saturday)
- Pickup timings: 7:00 AM, 7:30 AM, 8:00 AM (morning); 5:00 PM, 5:30 PM, 6:00 PM (evening)
- Booking via WhatsApp in under 60 seconds

## Locations Served

- [Sharjah](/locations/sharjah): Al Nahda, Al Khan, Al Majaz, Al Taawun, Rolla, Al Qasimia, Al Qusais, Muwaileh, University City, Industrial Area
- [Dubai](/locations/dubai): Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown Dubai, JLT, Dubai Marina, Media City, Tecom, Al Qouz
- [Ajman](/locations/ajman): Al Nuaimiya, Al Rashidiya, Al Hamidiya
- [Business Bay](/locations/business-bay): Executive Towers, Bay Square, The Opus, Damac Towers
